The buildings , located on the premises of the sanctioned machine tool plant "Sasta" (Sasovo)  were reportedly hit by Ukrainian drones.  The fire was picked up by NASA Firms., , Sasta specializes in manufacturing CNC machine tools, including five-axis machining centers, turn-mill systems, and heavy-duty machine tools. Its equipment is used in Russia's defense, aerospace, transport, and heavy industries. According to the plant itself, it is included in Russia's consolidated register of defense industry organizations.
